list.title: Join the Etleq team
list.lead: We build software products for Gulf business owners and take them live in 30 working days. If you like careful work and clear deadlines, you may fit right in.
list.emptyBody: New roles are posted here first. Check back later.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Send your application from the role page. A person reads every one.

call.title: Intro call
call.body: A short call to get to know you and answer your questions.

task.title: Practical task
task.body: A short task close to the real work, with a clear time box.

meet.title: Meet the founders
meet.body: We talk through the task, how you work and what you expect from us.

offer.title: Offer
offer.body: A written offer with every detail. Every applicant hears back, whatever the outcome.

ownership.title: Real ownership
ownership.body: You own your work from first commit to launch, without layers of management.

craft.title: Careful work
craft.body: We build on one shared codebase that keeps getting better, and we sweat the details.

arabic.title: Arabic first
arabic.body: Our products are designed and written in Arabic first, for customers in the Gulf.

cycles.title: Clear deadlines
cycles.body: We work in launch cycles of 30 working days with the scope agreed up front.

small.title: A small team
small.body: A small senior team, so your impact shows from day one.

honest.title: Honest with clients
honest.body: We never promise clients revenue. We promise what we control: launching on time and support after.

job.metaDescription: {title} at Etleq, {location}. See the responsibilities and requirements, and apply directly on the page.

form.title: Apply for {title}
form.lead: It takes a few minutes. We review every application ourselves and reply to everyone.
form.consent: I agree that Etleq may process my details and CV for recruitment, as described in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>. They are kept for a limited time and then deleted.
form.note: Your details are only shared with the hiring team.

errors.invalid: Please check the highlighted fields and send again.
errors.rateLimited: You've sent several applications in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.spam: We couldn't verify the submission. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.closed: This role is no longer accepting applications. Have a look at our other open roles.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side and your application wasn't saved. Please try again shortly.

closed.title: Applications for {title} are closed
closed.body: Thanks for your interest. This role is no longer open, but one of our current roles may suit you.
closed.noneOpen: There are no open roles right now. New roles are posted on the careers page first.
